title: In situ Pt single-atom trapping on TiO2 nanotubes via ultrasonication: a one-pot approach to produce active electrodes for electrocatalytic H2 evolution
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, 8,5839-5847
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01214C, Paper
Sina Hejazi, Sadegh Pour-Ali, Ali Kosari, Nastaran Farahbakhsh, Manuela S. Killian, Shiva Mohajernia
In the present study, we demonstrate a straightforward sonochemical approach for in situ defect formation and Pt single-atoms (SAs) decoration of anodic TiO2 nanotubes (TNTs).
